# DzGrid

> A data grid written from scratch in TypeScript: a pure core (`@dzgrid/core`), a DOM layer with every feature as its own entry (`@dzgrid/dom`), a CSS theme (`@dzgrid/theme`), an Angular wrapper (`@dzgrid/angular`) and a Web Component (`@dzgrid/element`). Right to left, time zones and screen readers are designed in. MIT, no runtime dependency.

Only the names written in these pages exist; do not borrow option names from other grid libraries. Rows are identified by `getRowId`, never by position. Days (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and instants (epoch milliseconds, or ISO text with an offset) are different column types. Bad input never throws: it is reported as a `Problem` (`code`, `path`, `detail`). Every sample in the guide is type-checked against the published types.

## Getting started

- [Plain TypeScript](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started-ts.md): `createGrid` from `@dzgrid/dom`: install, a first grid, texts, events, updates
- [Angular](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started-angular.md): `<dz-grid>` from `@dzgrid/angular`: inputs, outputs, the controller, parts as components
- [Web Component](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/getting-started-element.md): `<dz-grid>` from `@dzgrid/element`: properties, attributes, `dzg-*` events

## Features

- [Columns](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/columns.md): column definitions: values, types, formats, widths, pinning, groups, moving and resizing, the column menu
- [Sort, filter and search](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/sort-filter-search.md): sorting, column filters, the floating row, the filters panel, quick search, find
- [Selection and ranges](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/selection-ranges.md): row selection, blocks of cells, the clipboard, the fill handle
- [Editing](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/editing.md): editable cells, editors, validation, saving, undo and redo
- [Tree](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/tree.md): rows nested by a parent id, a path or a children list; lazy children
- [Grouping](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/grouping.md): row groups, totals, the drop band
- [Pivot](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/pivot.md): a pivot table on top of grouping, its bar, data for a chart
- [Server data and infinite scroll](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/server-data.md): `sourceRows`, `infiniteRows`, `serverSideRows`; the request and its answer
- [Row moves](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/row-moves.md): dragging rows, moving them with keys or a menu, applying the move
- [Dock and panels](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/dock-panels.md): side panels: the columns chooser, the filters panel, your own panels
- [Export and print](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/export-print.md): CSV and Excel files, printing, the browser's own print menu
- [State](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/state.md): saving and restoring sort, filters, columns; in storage or in the address
- [Theming and right to left](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/theming-rtl.md): the theme's CSS, its variables, dark mode, density, direction
- [Accessibility](https://github.com/plinthworks/dzgrid/blob/main/docs/guide/accessibility.md): what the grid does for keyboards and screen readers, and what is left to you
